title: polly-api is live
summary: 🚀 drop-in OpenAI compatibility means you can run our open models with your existing stack. zero friction—just change the base URL. also shipped: Qwen3Guard 8B safety + fixed grok video ratios. open source moves fast. 🐝✨

highlights.title: Polly API
highlights.text: Access Polly's web research and coding skills via a new OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Check the [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs).

highlights.title: New Safety Model
highlights.text: Qwen3Guard-8B is now available via the API for fast content moderation and safety classification.

highlights.title: Showcase Upgrade
highlights.text: Explore the redesigned [App Showcase](https://hello.pollinations.ai) with AI-enhanced descriptions and real-time usage metrics.

highlights.title: Community Apps
highlights.text: New additions include the "Nova Defense" Discord bot and the AI-powered Roblox game "Convince the CRAZY Idol".
